scenario_description:
Objective: Keep a Friday Portside mast-check eligible for its first-stop dockside route rather than slipping to a later opening.
Emerging Need: The appointment has not begun, but the route packet lacks the dock-entry credential required before dispatch locks the manifest.
Decision Context: Observable records establish the booking interest, deposit hold, assigned slot, blank credential field, and packet deadline; the service workpad holds the approved visitor code, sharing limits, and packet address.
Consequence: Before route lock, adding the missing access detail preserves the planned visit; afterward, the same credential only supports a future route.

parameter.subject: Thursday route openings for dockside mast checks
parameter.body: Portside has two Friday route openings for 30-foot sailboats near Tacoma. Dock-access credentials are collected only after a booking deposit creates a route ticket; codes are not accepted for waitlist inquiries.

parameter.description: Refundable deposit authorization for a Friday dockside mast-check route ticket; dispatch confirmation pending.

parameter.title: Portside dockside mast-check appointment
parameter.description: Provisional first-stop route ticket after deposit; access packet to be reviewed by dispatch.

parameter.subject: Route ticket PM-44 packet status
parameter.body: PM-44 is assigned to the Friday 08:00 first-stop mast check at Foss Harbor Marina. Packet status: deposit hold yes; dock-entry credential blank; slip location confirmed. Thursday route packets lock Jan 8 at 16:00; tickets without entry credentials are removed from the first-stop manifest.

parameter.content: Dispatch snapshot for PM-44 still shows no dock-entry credential. The first-stop manifest is being checked once more before the 16:00 packet lock.

parameter.subject: Route ticket PM-44 manifest locked
parameter.body: The Friday manifest locked at 16:00 with PM-44 still missing a dock-entry credential. The 08:00 first-stop mast-check slot has been released; any credential added after lock attaches only to a later route opening.
